title: Private network acceptance automation and model readiness harness
creator: Lina Zhang
description:
Objective: build an automated acceptance harness that runs immediately after Private (customer VPC / private-network) deployments and upgrades. The harness must validate API readiness, model hot-load and inference smoke tests, and basic SLA gates so we can confidently mark a deployment 'ready' without manual intervention.

Scope:
- Terraform/IaC module post-apply checks (module output sanity, networking reachability).
- API readiness probe sequence (control-plane handshake, auth, quota, route mapping).
- Model load validation: spawn model process, verify KV cache warmup cycle, issue a set of golden prompts and compare logits/response signatures to baseline.
- Lightweight load smoke: short burst (5–30 qps) for 60s to ensure sequencing, memory, and concurrency shape behave.
- Rollback/rollback-signal hooks if critical gates fail.

Acceptance criteria:
1) A deployment run (applied via terraform) triggers the harness automatically and emits a pass/fail artifact to S3.
2) API readiness check completes within 45s under normal conditions; failures recorded and triaged.
3) Model smoke tests return matching response signatures for at least 90% of golden prompts; mismatches produce a detailed diff artifact.
4) Load smoke does not exceed configured latency SLOs (p50 < 50ms token) for the checked model variant.
5) If critical checks fail, infra is marked degraded and an automated rollback flag is created for the release engineer.

Implementation notes:
- The harness is implemented as a short-lived runner invoked by the Terraform pipeline (post-apply hook). See: infra/ci/postapply-runners/private-acceptance-runner.
- Use the same service-account that deploys infra but scoped to a restricted role for probing only (least privilege). Token scoping issues were the most common blocker in previous runs; include retries and clearer error messages.
- Golden prompts and expected response signatures live in: gs://redwood-internal/test-baselines/private-acceptance/ (versioned). We compute a lightweight fingerprint of logits + token sequence rather than exact text match to allow deterministic quantization differences.
- For model load validation, we exercise three model sizes (small/medium/large) and a minimal KV-cache priming sequence that mirrors application-request distribution.

Runbook (high level):
1) Terraform apply completes and triggers CICD step 'private-acceptance-check'.
2) Runner performs networking/connectivity checks (VPC peering, SG, route table sanity).
3) Perform API handshake: auth -> ping -> schema fetch -> sample request.
4) Load model instances and run golden prompt set. Collect response signatures and perf metrics.
5) Run short load smoke (burst) and verify latency and error budget.
6) Aggregate results, upload artifacts (logs, diffs, metrics) and mark release in the deployments dashboard.

Observability and metrics:
- Expose a dedicated Grafana dashboard sheet (dashboard id: private-accept-2026) showing success rate, time-to-ready, median token latency, model-loading duration, and golden-prompt match ratio.
- Emit an event to Sentry with a standard schema on failure to capture stack traces and process-level errors.

Rollback criteria:
- Immediate rollback if API handshake fails or model load fails for more than 2 model variants.
- Conditional rollback (alert + manual approval) if load smoke exceeds configured p95 latency threshold for 3 consecutive runs.

Upgrade considerations:
- When module versions change (terraform module semver bump), run acceptance harness against a canary subnet (traffic=5%) before global promotion.
- Maintain a compatibility matrix between runtime-1.xx releases and model quantization profiles; mismatches should be flagged as a release blocker.

Notes on false positives:
- Transient DNS or IAM issues have been observed; harness implements exponential backoff with a 3-attempt window before declaring a hard failure.

Next steps:
- Finalize runner image and add to CI templates (PR #7428).
- Add baseline golden prompts for the two customer-critical models.
- Create dashboards and link to onboarding playbook.
